title: Causal detector-cluster construction preflight

scope.events: Construct detector events only from a supplied causal record prefix and declared check coordinates.
scope.clusters: Form deterministic snapshot connected components under a registered spacetime L-infinity adjacency radius.
scope.summaries: Report age, inclusive extent, nearest-cluster separation, nearest active absorber, and geometric absorber-link candidates.
scope.schedule_handoff: Convert only clusters touching the current detector frontier into abstract Lyons-Brown schedule inputs.
not_in_scope: persistent cluster identity under arbitrary future merges
ILP inference of correction strings or fusion channels
schedule performance, threshold, or fault tolerance

registered_parameters.candidate_link_rule: active external absorber distance <= 2 * inclusive cluster extent
registered_parameters.event_time: detector row r represents the transition ending at readout round r+1

invariants: only detector rows present in the causal prefix are visible
check coordinates match the detector width and share one dimension
each detector event belongs to exactly one deterministic component
cluster age and extent are computed from explicit spacetime coordinates
nearest-cluster separation is symmetric and excludes self
only active external absorbers contribute distance and link candidates
schedule handoff requires at least one current-frontier event
schedule detector vertices are current, sorted, unique, and record-visible

verified_cases: causal detector events form deterministic spacetime connected components
age, inclusive extent, and symmetric nearest-cluster separation are explicit
active absorbers supply nearest distance and registered geometric link candidates
terminated and cluster-owned absorbers are excluded
only current-frontier clusters can become abstract schedule inputs
a constructed cluster drives the public Lyons-Brown defer path and record reversal
malformed prefix horizons and coordinate contracts are rejected

claim_boundary: This contract verifies a bounded causal snapshot constructor and its schedule handoff. It does not establish that the registered adjacency/link rules are physically optimal, reproduce persistent Lyons-Brown cluster tracking, or imply any noisy-channel or threshold result.
next_gate: After snapshot construction passes, test persistent cluster identity and merge/link updates across successive causal prefixes before a noisy-measurement pilot.
